Links the app wrote (toLink in src/ui/link.ts) for the designs named,
with the configuration each carries on the line before it. Read by
test/craft-roundtrip.test.tsx. Regenerate with the recipe in
tools/README.md when a fixture is added; a codec change shows as a
diff here, which is the point of committing them.
